season.evidence: Web: Clark/Luahna parties go in July-Sept; a Nov 2024 trip found the Little Giant route snowed over; June parties meet poor snow on the Clark Glacier. Stored Jul-Oct kept.

otherTracksConsidered.why: Starts at White River trailhead on the Clark-Luahna-Chalangin traverse, not Little Giant Pass.

facts.text: From the Luahna col, staying on the ridge crest means a few class 5 moves and lots of class 4; the terrain just west of the crest is class 2-3 with some snow in late June.
From the col a ledge system with a short downclimb leads across slab to scree and the ridge; around mid-August it is dry.
Return from the summit staying slightly west of the ridge to reach the col easily.

season.evidence: Stored text says late May-Sep, header says May-Jun; web: Nov 2024 attempts on the White River line stopped by avalanche danger, lowland snow lingers late spring. Months uncertain.

otherTracksConsidered.why: Starts at White River trailhead but climbs via Clark and Luahna and the col ridge, not Thunder Creek/Chalangin Basin SW face.

notes: All harvested tracks are Clark-Luahna-Chalangin traverses from the White River trailhead (consistent with our pin 47.96285,-120.945). None climbs either stored route.
